name: optax-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Optax, a gradient processing and optimization library for JAX. It defines
an interface for gradient transformations, a library of transformations and of the ways to combine and wrap
them, ready-made optimizers built from those pieces, learning-rate schedules, loss functions and utilities
for working with trees of parameters.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this part of the repository.
Everything in scope is Optax's core library: everything in the optax/ package except the optax/contrib/, optax/experimental/, optax/assignment/, optax/microbatching/, optax/perturbations/ and optax/projections/ subpackages. That is the package entry point optax/__init__.py; optax/_src/ (the transformation interface, the optimizer aliases and the transformations, wrappers and helpers they are built from); optax/transforms/; optax/schedules/; optax/tree_utils/ and optax/tree/; optax/losses/; and optax/second_order/; together with the module, class and function docstrings of those modules and these pages: README.md, docs/index.rst, and the API reference pages docs/api/apply_updates.rst, docs/api/combining_optimizers.rst, docs/api/losses.rst, docs/api/optimizer_schedules.rst, docs/api/optimizer_wrappers.rst, docs/api/optimizers.rst, docs/api/transformations.rst and docs/api/utilities.rst.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
